environment.description: Flask application deployed on EC2 instance, connecting to MongoDB 6.0 Atlas cluster (M10 tier). Application user 'app_user' has readWrite role on the 'multitenant' database with no additional access restrictions. MongoDB connection uses default driver settings. No request filtering proxy in front of the application. Network: application connects directly to MongoDB cluster endpoint over TLS with no intermediate query inspection layer.

config.network: direct EC2 to MongoDB Atlas peering
